box: Box C -- determinism across reload. Same pair, same click order, reloaded, same Bangkok day -> identical score and line.
method: scripts/driver.mjs, one CDP tab. Wiped storage on-origin, added ก้อง and ฟ้า via the named-entry path, clicked #start-round, picked ก้อง then ฟ้า, recorded the score/line/date paragraphs. Navigated (full reload, same tab) back to /game/love-match/, verified the reload landed back on the SETUP panel (not a resumed round -- checked #player-setup.hidden === false and empty #stage, matching love-match's no-mid-round-checkpoint design), verified the roster was still pre-ticked (ก้อง, ฟ้า) without re-adding, clicked #start-round again, and picked ก้อง then ฟ้า again in the SAME order (this box tests reload-determinism, not order-independence, which is Box B) -- then compared the score/line/date paragraphs bit for bit. Recorded process.env-side UTC timestamps (node's own Date.now, not the page's) immediately before and after the whole run so a Bangkok-midnight straddle (UTC 17:00:00) would be visible rather than assumed away.
capturedAtCommitNote: Working tree is dirty at capture time; this walk verifies uncommitted work, not a clean HEAD. git status --short showed: ' M src/games/manifest.ts', '?? public/og/love-match.png', '?? src/games/love-match.test.mjs', '?? src/games/love-match.ts'. The capture reflects the tree as it stood at run time.

observation.note_on_utc_window: Both timestamps are 2026-08-15T17:38:xx UTC, i.e. ~38 minutes after the 2026-08-15T17:00:00Z Bangkok-midnight boundary that started the current Bangkok day (2026-08-16). The whole run (under 4 seconds) sits entirely inside that day, roughly 23h20m before the next boundary -- no straddle occurred.
